verdict.rationale: Convex documents a CLI (`npx convex dev/run/import/insights`) that pushes schema and function changes automatically, and supports optional schemas plus auth libraries (Convex Auth, Clerk) — all scriptable to some degree. However there is no evidence of a single non-interactive CLI flow that provisions auth providers or authorization policies headlessly, and 'convex dev' is documented as a filesystem-watching process rather than a pure one-shot script command; policies/authorization are hand-written code, not CLI-configurable. missing for 10: headless/non-interactive CLI commands for auth provider setup, evidence of scripted 'policy' provisioning, and a documented one-shot init-and-deploy script example.
